name: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography

angles.text: Archmage Antonidas was one of the Kirin Tor's greatest leaders and a paragon of arcane scholarship. His life and personal writings offer vital insight to any practitioner of the arcane arts.
The tome comes from the great library in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. The scholars receiving it seem unconcerned about depriving the dwarven archivists of such a rare volume.
Antonidas was a revered human archmage who led the Kirin Tor and Dalaran through the Second and Third Wars. His unabridged autobiography is a precious piece of human history.
Antonidas was a pillar of the Alliance of Lordaeron against the Orcish Horde and the Scourge. His personal memoirs are a treasured historical record across Alliance lands.

faq.answer: Archmage Antonidas led the Kirin Tor for many years and ruled the magical city-state of Dalaran. A legendary master of the arcane, he was a key councilor to the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War. He warned King Terenas about the plague before falling in defense of Dalaran during the Third War.

Archmage Antonidas wrote the comprehensive autobiography himself, recounting his life, scholarship, and leadership within Dalaran. As head of the Kirin Tor, his writings are an invaluable record of history and magic.
The volume came from the library in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Dwarven explorers and archivists often collect historical and magical texts from across the eastern continents.
faq.q: Where did this book come from?

aliases: why does the library want this
faq.answer: Scholars and librarians seek powerful or historic magical texts to expand their archives and preserve arcane knowledge. Works by legendary magi are especially sought after, lest they be lost or hidden in foreign collections.
faq.q: Why is this book being sought after?

faq.answer: Archmage Antonidas perished during the Third War when the fallen Prince Arthas Menethil and the Scourge invaded Dalaran. Antonidas raised a powerful magical barrier to defend the city and its secrets. Arthas breached the defenses and struck him down to claim the Book of Medivh.
The recipient dismisses concern that the dwarves will notice the book's absence. The Ironforge archives are so vast that one missing tome will likely go unnoticed.
faq.q: Will the Ironforge library notice the book is gone?

sections.body: Archmage Antonidas led the Kirin Tor for decades and ruled Dalaran. One of Azeroth's most brilliant minds, he rose through the ranks of the Violet Citadel and mastered the arcane. His unabridged autobiography records his leadership during the Second and Third Wars. For scholars and practitioners of magic, it offers a firsthand view of Dalaran's inner workings and the arcane arts.
sections.title: The Words of the Grand Magus

sections.body: Before reaching its new home, the rare manuscript rested in Ironforge's grand library. In the Hall of Explorers, dwarven archivists kept it beside ancient titan relics and dwarven histories. Their vast collections hold texts gathered from ruins and foreign kingdoms across Azeroth. Yet arcane scholars elsewhere seek such works for their own collections, sure the busy archivists will never notice one missing volume.
sections.title: From the Great Library of Ironforge

summary: In Ironforge, you seek Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography. The rare volume holds the late Kirin Tor leader's own account and offers insight into Dalaran's history and high arcane scholarship.
